entries.name: Claude Code: shell tool launcher
entries.note: Runs whatever script Claude Code puts in the env var, in-process. Commands it runs are not separate processes, so allowlisting this hides nothing beyond the launcher itself; processes it spawns are still evaluated.

entries.name: Claude Code: PowerShell command parser
entries.note: Matches on the first 48 decoded characters of the payload ('function Write-Result($Json) { [System.Con...'), not the whole thing: a payload with the same opening would also match. Pin the full base64 here to close that gap.

entries.name: VS Code updater: query installed AppX package
VS Code updater: register AppX package
VS Code updater: remove old AppX package
VS Code updater: stop Explorer context-menu host
entries.command_line: "?(?:C:\\Windows\\(?:System32|SysWOW64)\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1\.0\\)?powershell\.exe"? -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ""Name = \'dllhost\.exe\'"" \| Where-Object \{ \$_\.CommandLine -like \'\*/Processid:1C6DF0C0-192A-4451-BE36-6A59A86A692E\*\' \} \| ForEach-Object \{ try \{ Stop-Process -Id \$_\.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop \} catch \{\} \}"

entries.name: VS Code updater: setup executables in temp
entries.note: Path-only match: any file dropped in temp under this name would also match. Add a parent_image matcher to tighten it.
